title: Jagged Smoky Peruvian Shrimp Chupe De Camarones
description: A smoky and crumbly Peruvian dish featuring shrimp and egg wash, perfect for a weeknight dinner. This ovo-vegetarian-friendly recipe is a variation of the traditional chupe de camarones.
instructions: Heat the oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the onions and garlic and saute until the onions are translucent.
Add the bhuna spice mix and smoked paprika and cook for 1 minute.
Add the shrimp and cook until they are pink and fully cooked.
Remove the shrimp from the pot and set them aside.
Add the diced tomatoes and chicken broth to the pot and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes.
Stir in the beaten eggs to create a creamy sauce.
Return the shrimp to the pot and cook until the sauce has thickened.
Serve the chupe de camarones hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
